findings.reason: Instance of the TSC module, explicitly named 'Trojan', which is not part of standard AES-128 and monitors internal round keys and state.
Module implementing a Trojan Side-Channel or trigger mechanism that monitors state and round keys to shift internal registers.
Signal that computes a parity-like combination of state and round key bits to enable shifting of a register, characteristic of a side-channel Trojan trigger.
Shift register that shifts based on state and round key combinations, likely used to leak key information or track trigger states.
